It's almost 6pm and says he doesn't know when it will end, but that there are 2 more streamers left. I feel like the evening is almost over and I am so disappointed and feel saddened that he would rather watch games than spend time with me. Am I an asshole for being upset and having unrealistic expectations?

The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) consistently demonstrated respect for his family, spending quality time with them and prioritizing their emotional needs. Expecting your husband to pause personal hobbies for family time is not "unreasonable"—it is a fundamental aspect of a healthy, balanced marriage. - **His behavior is problematic:** His refusal to stop streaming for family time, coupled with a history of excessive in-app purchases ($2,000 last year), reflects a lack of balance and respect for your needs. Your request for family time is justified and rooted in both Islamic values and healthy relationship dynamics. The issue lies with his inability to compromise and respect your needs.
